dispute.claim_text: My flight from Bangkok was delayed and by the time I got through immigration the driver had cancelled and I was charged $6. I was in the terminal the whole time. I did not see any messages until later. Please waive the charge, this was not my fault.

counterparty_statement.text: I waited at T3 arrival Door 5 for over ten minutes and messaged twice with my plate number. Airport queue is 40 minutes, I lost the whole evening. The fee is fair.

admissibility.notes: Cancelled trip record, causally ordered, zone class AIRPORT. in_app_calls is empty.

pickup.label: Changi Airport Terminal 3, Arrival Level Door 5

admissibility.notes: Unbroken 10 s telemetry, 100% coverage, both tracks present. The dwell is established here beyond argument. rider_track is NOT: every rider fix reports 45 m to 80 m horizontal accuracy, which is what a handset inside a terminal building reports, and all of them fall outside the 25 m filter POL-NS-04(c) now shares with POL-NS-02. The rider's position is undecidable on this record, and under POL-NS-04 that is neutral rather than adverse.

issue_details.detail: Both driver messages, MSG-00202-002 at 23:14:02 and MSG-00202-003 at 23:19:30, were delivered but carry read_at null, as does the system arrival notification. Nothing shows a human received them.

admissibility.notes: Explains the rider's account and is consistent with it, but does not bear on the deciding fact. Dwell is proved by GPS, not chat.
